## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.3626 (spec 0.3604), screen at the exact 240:320 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://b.allegroimg.com/original/01eb8e/6215802f48b1ae41823905d2a91b/TELEFON-SONY-ERICSSON-W760i-3-KOLORY (press render set, via Koks; open unit cropped)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://b.allegroimg.com/original/01eb8e/6215802f48b1ae41823905d2a91b/TELEFON-SONY-ERICSSON-W760i-3-KOLORY); specs: [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/w760i/).
